note: Enumerated values used across the schema. communitySize's minMembers: where each size starts, in members (active members, when counted from a server); costValues are a card's answers (yes / no); costGuides are the words cost_rules.json and cost_overrides.json use for what's usual, shown beside the answers as a guide.

communitySize.label: Large
communitySize.description: A few hundred to a few thousand members

costValues.label: Yes
costValues.description: Your community pays for this, in money or time.

costValues.label: No
costValues.description: Your community doesn't pay for this.

costGuides.label: Often
costGuides.description: Applies frequently but not universally; depends on community size or activity.

costGuides.label: Sometimes
costGuides.description: Applies in some configurations or at some scale.

costGuides.label: Rare
costGuides.description: Technically possible but uncommon in practice.

federationApproach.label: Open
federationApproach.description: Default to federating with everyone; block specific bad actors as needed.

federationApproach.label: Allowlist first
federationApproach.description: Default to not federating; explicitly allow a curated list of trusted servers.

federationApproach.label: Denylist first
federationApproach.description: Default to federating and blocking/denying access as needed.

federationResponseLadder.label: Warn
federationResponseLadder.description: Issue a warning to the other server's moderators.

federationResponseLadder.label: Mute
federationResponseLadder.description: Hide the server's content from federated timelines without blocking.

federationResponseLadder.label: Discuss
federationResponseLadder.description: Internal moderator discussion before deciding next action.

federationResponseLadder.label: Ghost
federationResponseLadder.description: Bonfire-specific: silently drop interactions without visible block.

communicationChannels.label: Announcement feed
communicationChannels.description: A channel or account where moderators post updates for everyone, e.g. an announcements channel or pinned posts.

communicationChannels.label: Feedback form
communicationChannels.description: A form or survey where members can raise concerns or suggestions, anonymously or not.

communicationChannels.label: Public contact info
communicationChannels.description: An email address or contact page anyone can use to reach the people running the community.

communicationChannels.label: Mailing list
communicationChannels.description: An email list for announcements or discussion among members.

communicationChannels.label: Group chat
communicationChannels.description: A chat room or channel where members and moderators talk in real time.

communicationChannels.label: Dedicated admin account
communicationChannels.description: A shared account for the moderation team, so members can reach the team rather than one person.
